steps.content: Around when do you get up every day? / Drinking fresh water right after waking up is supposed to help.
The ventilation in the second-year classrooms is seriously great, don’t you think? / Yeah, we gotta plan ahead for that.
What do you do when we don’t have school? / Better rest when you can.
So… what are your thoughts on us getting in the same class?
I’ve decided I’m gonna become a good student. / I’ll correct the school’s moral values.
How’s your outside of school club thing? / Maybe I’ll start a Meteor Strike Club.
Oh yeah, did you hear we’re supposedly getting more vending machines this month? / I’d personally love to see strawberry milk.
Is it just me, or does this town get like really crowded / Yeah, too many people can be a problem in and of itself.
Dang nice weather we’ve been having recently, don’t you think? / But if you think about, we’d run out of water without rain.
So yeah, we’re upperclassman. How’s it feel to have kids younger than us here now? / You sound pretty worked up over it. Don’t worry yourself to death over it, okay?
It’s pretty amazing how convenient cell phones are today, don’t you think? / Oh, I could help you out with yours sometime if you want?
You know, I don’t think I’ve ever seen you come late to school. / Yeah, you’re just kinda hurting yourself by coming in late.
What kinda books you like reading these days? / Yeah, thought I’d see what the experience is like compared to manga.

Do you believe in love at first sight? / Isn’t it an instinctual kinda thing?

What’s the girls’ impression of me? / Wow, thanks! Hearing that from you really boosts my self-confidence.

What are your thoughts on cheating? / I would definitely be faithful to the girl I love.
